''See also: [[Crusher Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Crusher is a powerful entity residing within the soul of [[Yan Shoumei]]. Manifesting as a massive, muscular being with features reminiscent of a gorilla, a wolf, and a rabbit, he stands more than twice the height of Yan Shoumei{{!}}Shoumei. His composition is unique, consisting of more than just [[madra]]; he incorporates stolen [[willpower]], elements from twelve distinct [[sacred beasts]], and a [[fragment]] of the [[Strength Icon]]. While he does not possess the qualities of an [[Underlord]], he radiates a sense of immense physical power that can manipulate the fundamental rules of the physical world, similar to the abilities held by [[Monarchs]] or [[Heralds]]. In combat, Crusher acts as a formidable force, capable of roaring upon manifestation and engaging enemies such as the [[Blood Shadow]] or an [[Archlord]]. Despite his overwhelming strength, he has faced significant damage, including being nearly destroyed by Wei Shi Lindon Arelius{{!}}Lindon Arelius and losing limbs during battles against powerful spirits. He functions as a specialized combatant, though his development was hindered because he was unable to advance without freedom. When his physical form is dispersed, he can return to Yan Shoumei{{!}}Shoumei as a red stream of essence.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Crusher is a snarling monster of [[blood]]. This [[Blood Shadow]] resides within the depths of [[Yan Shoumei]]'s soul.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As a companion and enhanced [[Shadow]] belonging to [[Yan Shoumei]], Crusher is an entity she relies on to take risks. The creature is described as a beast.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Crusher possesses incredible dexterity and leg strength that functions on a conceptual level, allowing the creature to bend physical rules. This power is bolstered by stolen [[willpower]], the weight of twelve unique [[sacred beasts]], and a sliver of the [[Strength Icon]].}}
